text: Skin AI brings photo observations and product label evidence into one simple daily routine. It is designed for people overwhelmed by skincare choices, without shopping links or paid placements.
caption:
SKIN AI · Your Daily Edit
Photo observations, personal context and traceable product labels.

text: Your answers come first. Select how your skin usually feels, your goals, sensitivity and any prescribed treatment. A photo never fills in an unknown skin type or diagnoses a condition.
caption:
Your answers control the filters.
A photo does not diagnose skin type or choose a treatment.

text: For this demonstration, we use an AI generated fictional adult portrait. Nothing is sent until permission and provider consent are confirmed. The image is normalized and its metadata removed on the server.
caption:
Fictional AI-generated adult · Permission and provider consent
This demonstration is an integration test, not an accuracy study.

text: This is one real YouCam analysis request. The app uploads the photo, starts an asynchronous task, and checks the same task for its result. Any processing wait is shortened in this video.
caption:
ONE REAL YOUCAM TASK · Processing wait may be shortened
The app polls the same task; it does not resubmit the photo.

text: Six raw observations and available visual maps appear alongside the routine. The scores provide context, not clinical severity. The routine keeps morning care to cleansing, moisturizing and sun protection.
caption:
Six real observations and visual maps
Raw scores provide cosmetic context, not clinical severity.

text: The data pipeline extracted eighty official manufacturer records. Thirty pass the limited release rules. Each option exposes its source, capture date, skin type label and ingredient list, with general guidance linked separately.
caption:
80 official records → 30 limited-release records
Product names omitted in the recording; full label sources are available in the app.

text: Now add niacinamide to the ingredients to avoid. The options are filtered against the captured formula without sending another photo. An unresolved ingredient or unknown prescription withholds named options rather than guessing.
caption:
Edit an ingredient restriction · Reuse the same analysis
Captured US formulas are screened; your exact local package still needs checking.

text: The evening view contains two basic steps. Every choice has an explanation, alternatives where available and clear limits. This is a starting point for care, not a prescription.
caption:
Morning: three essentials · Evening: two essentials
Explained options, with uncertainty kept visible.

text: Skin AI. Less guesswork, more understanding. Built with YouCam, and grounded in traceable labels.
caption:
SKIN AI · Less guesswork. More understanding.
